name: You make this house a sit-com
source:
You wake up in a house you don't recognize with a man you don't recogni-
Wait a minute... Hasn't this... happened before..???
 Turns out, this isn't your anniversary after all. Its... National Domestic Bliss Day?????
The one day a year where everything is perfect and normal and absolutely nothing concerning or out of the ordinary happens at all. Yup. Nothing to see here. 
CUE THE LAUGH TRACK!!!

[From [url=https://www.tumblr.com/jul1xan/812663171867394048/the-parody-game-for-you-make-this-house-a-home-is]Tumbrl[/url]]

April fools short game based on the original.
